headline: Xz surges from 1,274th to fourth on ARC-3

sections.text: Xz added 24.54 points to reach 52.95, vaulting from 1,274th to fourth on the public board.
That advance puts Xz inside the gold places and among the leaders, a sharp change in the ARC-3 chase.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
